caption: The drawing shows an intricately designed capelet or mantle with a high collar. The main section is black with an inner blue lining visible on the collar. The central area of the capelet is densely decorated with white star-like patterns and linear beaded embellishments radiating outward, accented by small colored dots that may represent jewels or beads. The side panels are composed of a diamond or mesh pattern made from interconnected lines and dots, bordered by vertical bead-like elements forming a decorative fringe along the bottom edge. To the lower right of the main image is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same garment, rendered in a grayscale outline without color, showing the same pattern and structural details in a less finished state. The composition centers the main colored illustration on a plain, beige background, with the secondary outline positioned nearby for reference.
title: Cape
